Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production thumbnail illustration for a Japanese children's web-app collection, one of a coherent five-image series.
Create ONE landscape 3:2 image, preferably 1536x1024. Sophisticated yet friendly soft 3D toy illustration, rounded simplified forms, smooth matte clay/vinyl surfaces, soft diffuse studio lighting from upper left, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained little highlights, no harsh black outlines. Think a tiny tactile toy diorama, front three-quarter slightly elevated camera, clean silhouette readable at 350px wide. Palette: periwinkle blue #5876e8, warm yellow #ffcf61, soft pink #efb0c5, mint green #8fcfb6, off-white #f7f9fc. Use a seamless pale pastel background with a gentle contact shadow under the objects, no hard horizon. Main subjects completely visible and clustered in center, occupy about 65% of width and 65% of height. Keep upper-left 25% wide by 20% high quiet for a category badge that the website overlays. Nothing touching the edges. Editorial polish and careful balance, joyful but uncluttered. No website UI, no screenshot, no phone frame around the image, no titles, no letters, no watermarks, no borders. Only the few subject-specific props described below.
Subject: AR indoor treasure hunt. A rounded golden-yellow little treasure chest, lid open with one glowing faceted yellow star treasure inside. Next to it a small upright periwinkle-blue toy smartphone, its pale screen shows just a simple mint circular radar with a dot and three arcs, no text. A faint dotted trail on a tiny rounded pale-blue floor platform connects phone to treasure, conveying finding hidden treasure with AR. Tiny blue and yellow sparkles, only two. Background pale blue #eaf0fe. Chest is hero, smartphone secondary, no pirates or skulls, no money.
